name: Code listing with syntax colours
description: Syntax-highlighted source code with line numbers, a light background and a caption.
notes: `\lstset{style=mystyle}` applies the style everywhere. Override per listing with `[language=C, ...]`.
listings doesn't handle UTF-8 (é, ü, →) in code out of the box. Add `literate={é}{{\'e}}1` or switch to `minted`.
`minted` has nicer highlighting (Pygments) but needs `-shell-escape`. listings works everywhere, Overleaf included.
